## Internship Experience

**Huawei (XiaoYi) — Image Security Risk Control**
:   2024.12 – 2025.12
    - Built risk-sample generation and automated evaluation tooling for multimodal content safety and image moderation (political metaphors, pornography, violence), supporting iterative improvement of moderation models.
    - Achieved 83% detection rate on political metaphors with <0.3% false-positive degradation; <1% general-capability drop after safety alignment of generative models.

**Meituan (In-Store R&D Platform) — Dish Knowledge Graph Construction**
:   2023.05 – 2024.01
    - Cross-modal ingredient recognition and attribute completion for Chinese food understanding.
    - Built the CMIngre cross-modal ingredient-level dataset via object detection and image-text retrieval; attribute accuracy 96.52%, coverage 87.01%, item-recognition error reduced from 20.38% to 2.3%.

## Project Experience

**Multi-Agent Driven AIGC Image Infringement Detection**
:   2025.08 – 2025.11
    - Addressed copyright-infringement detection between generated and copyrighted images.
    - Designed a "summarize–filter–judge" multi-agent framework with multi-role agent debate for explainable infringement detection; accuracy +4.33% and F1 +19.96% over traditional pretrained methods.
